$comment: Fingerprints proving each committed kernel patch really landed in an installed or PACKAGED dsh-runtime. scripts/verify-dsh-kernel-patches.cjs consumes this file: it fails when a patch file has no entry (adding a patch without a fingerprint is the silent-drop class of the v0.9.3 incident), when a listed patch file is gone, or when the marker count in the target file does not match. Keep `count` exact so a partially applied patch also fails. Paths are package-root relative, so the same entry works for a checkout and for an unpacked app's resources directory.

patches.why: CREATE_NO_WINDOW on all three raw CreateProcess spawn sites — a dropped patch silently brings back the Windows bash.exe console flash
ask_user_question declares and forwards the per-question `detail` context (bare-question incident f3ec66dc) and ignores model timeouts so the panel waits for a person
spill self-heal: recreate an externally deleted private spill directory instead of degrading to the bounded tail — matters on every platform
ENOTSUP fallback for the V4 log's hard-link publish — invisible on APFS/NTFS, fatal on exFAT/FAT32/SMB userData and every dev loop on the SSD worktrees
same ENOTSUP fallback for the attachment store's hard-link publish

automation approval (TICKET-2026-09-04): mutating Playwright-MCP browser tools ask through ctx.approval, fail-closed; lazy-browser-mount v2 (2026-10-16): agent/created defers the Playwright MCP spawn + Chromium to 8s after creation (background, Session-owned) — the memory spike of the spawn used to swap-stall memory-exhausted hosts for ~15s inside every new session's first turn; tools/execute still acquires on demand via resources.run(entry.ready)

targets.match: mutating browser tools need the approval service

patches.why: automation approval (TICKET-2026-09-04): mutating cua-driver desktop tools ask through ctx.approval, fail-closed — desktop input cannot be rolled back

targets.match: mutating desktop tools need the approval service

patches.why: truncated tool-call input JSON: conservative structural repair at tool-call settle (drop the incomplete tail member, close open containers, never complete a cut scalar) instead of a turn-fatal MALFORMED_RESPONSE; unrepairable input still throws so the host one-shot continue fallback applies, and every repair is reported through onToolInputRepaired

context-overflow recovery shrinks the summarized region (older half per rung) when the summarization request itself overflows the route's context window — without it a provider whose real prompt cap sits below the declared window (Command Code GLM, 2026-10-27 session 2c70849f) fails every turn with the same 400 and only a fallback brain on another provider can compact
